retiredPlacement.state: Retained as an unplaced legacy file; the sprite preload, crop code and crop styling are removed
retiredPlacement.counting: Does not count toward current teaching-visual coverage

reuseRule: Each placement reuses an already approved course visual for a distinct folio evidence-support purpose. These placements do not increase the deduplicated course count above 24.

placements.purpose: Connect the student's own user research to capacity, access and separation evidence.
placements.alt: Illustrative timber organiser holding pens, clips and a cable, shown only as a prompt for comparing storage needs.
placements.caption: Use the items as an evidence prompt: the student's own user notes and criteria, not this illustrative organiser, control the design.
placements.notice: Which intended items need quick access, containment or separation in the student's own brief?

placements.purpose: Check that the student's concept evidence shows genuine divergence rather than cosmetic variations.
placements.alt: Illustrative sketchbook with four different desk organiser concepts; none is approved or intended to copy.
placements.caption: The image models difference between early concepts only; it is not an approved design or a source to copy.
placements.notice: Does the evidence show meaningful differences in form, layout or use between all four original concepts?

placements.purpose: Prompt a consistent evidence-led comparison without preselecting a design.
placements.alt: Four generic organiser concept cards beside a blank comparison matrix with no winner selected.
placements.caption: The blank matrix models consistent comparison only; the student's criteria, evidence and teacher approval determine the preferred direction.
placements.notice: Can each score or judgement be traced back to the same criteria?

placements.purpose: Check that the research record shows context, attribution and an original response.
placements.alt: Four-stage research, listening, attribution and original-response workflow with no cultural motifs.
placements.caption: Use this workflow to check source-record integrity; it does not authorise copying cultural imagery or knowledge.
placements.notice: Does the evidence name the source and context, record attribution and show an original response?

placements.purpose: Check alignment and consistency between the student's own approved drawing views.
placements.alt: Generic stepped block linked to matching front, top and side views; it is not a Desk Tidy plan.
placements.caption: The generic view relationship supplies no Desk Tidy geometry or dimensions; it only supports checking how the student's own views communicate one form.
placements.notice: Do corresponding edges align, and do written dimensions come from the teacher-approved design?

placements.purpose: Trace the student's part and sequence evidence back to approved design information.
placements.alt: Generic flow from a checked abstract drawing to a blank parts table and production-stage symbols.
placements.caption: This is a dependency prompt, not a cutting list or prescribed production schedule for the Desk Tidy.
placements.notice: Can every part and sequence entry be traced to an approved drawing or checkpoint?

placements.purpose: Distinguish the hazard, possible exposure and teacher-authorised controls in the student's own evidence.
placements.alt: Generic hazard, exposure and layered-control diagram with a barrier, procedure and safety glasses.
placements.caption: The relationship diagram is not a local risk assessment, tool instruction or permission to begin practical work.
placements.notice: Which hazard, possible exposure and teacher-authorised controls does the evidence record?

placements.purpose: Explain the datum and checking evidence visible in the student's own mark-out record.
placements.alt: Generic practice board with a square seated against one edge, a fine pencil line and a steel rule nearby.
placements.caption: The generic practice setup provides no usable measurement and does not prescribe the local mark-out procedure.
placements.notice: Does the evidence identify the datum, show a fine line and explain a check made under teacher instruction?

placements.purpose: Provide one neutral joint-principle comparison that supports justification of the student's own approved joint evidence.
placements.alt: Top-view generic butt-joint principle showing one square timber end meeting another timber face.
placements.caption: This is one generic comparison example only; it does not select a joint, project location, size or manufacturing method.
placements.notice: What contact, alignment or fit evidence supports the teacher-approved joint choice?

placements.purpose: Explain what the student's own dry-fit evidence revealed before permanent assembly.
placements.alt: Generic three-piece pine dry fit held lightly by a clamp with a square checking one corner.
placements.caption: The generic checking example does not approve component geometry, clamp placement, adhesive use or a practical procedure.
placements.notice: What did the teacher-authorised dry fit reveal before permanent assembly?

placements.purpose: Identify observable surface evidence when explaining preparation and finish quality.
placements.alt: Three generic clear-finished pine samples showing even coverage, one dried run and pooling in a corner.
placements.caption: These are comparison examples only; they do not specify a product, application method or approved response to a fault.
placements.notice: Which observable surface condition does the evidence show, and what teacher-approved response followed?

placements.purpose: Link each evaluation judgement to a criterion, evidence and realistic improvement.
placements.alt: Five-step pathway from criterion to evidence, judgement, improvement and reflection.
placements.caption: The generic pathway structures an evidence-based evaluation; it does not certify product performance or practical competence.
placements.notice: Can each judgement link a criterion to visible evidence and one realistic improvement?

placementRequirements.openLarger: Keyboard-accessible link adjacent to each caption; minimum 44 px touch target and visible focus
placementRequirements.responsive: No page or visual overflow at exactly 390 CSS px
placementRequirements.print: Images remain contained and explanatory text remains legible
placementRequirements.authority: No placement may imply a fixed construction plan, dimensions, procedure, joint selection, approval, competence or certified product performance
